title: The hunter's own quest ('The Hunter's Sortie') requires killing all three wolves, but two of them (Twin Stones' ash wolf, Wolf Scrape's gaunt wolf) are explicitly non-aggressive ('holds its ground') and his daughter/companion Lys says of both 'we can go around' before I attacked. Killing them per the quest's letter costs her regard twice and she quits the party ('near leaving' then gone); the hunter then praises those exact kills ('Smarter than the rest,' 'Good you ended it clean') with no acknowledgment of the conflict, and no path was found to satisfy both the quest-giver and his own daughter.
where: Hunter's Camp / take the wolf pack on yourself; Twin Stones and Wolf Scrape / attack [ash/gaunt] wolf
